SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.price), 0) FROM `transaction` t WHERE t.counter_wallet_id = #{walletId} AND t.txn_type = 'TRANSFER' AND t.txn_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND t.txn_date < DATE_ADD(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)

SELECT c.campaign_id AS id, c.organization_id AS organizationId, o.name AS organization, c.title, c.category, c.target_amount AS targetAmount, c.raised_amount AS raised, c.participant_count AS participants, c.ends_at AS endsAt, CASE WHEN mdp.member_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS preferred FROM donation_campaign c JOIN donation_organization o ON o.organization_id = c.organization_id AND o.is_active = 1 LEFT JOIN member_donation_preference mdp ON mdp.organization_id = c.organization_id AND mdp.member_id = #{memberId} WHERE c.is_active = 1 AND (c.starts_at IS NULL OR c.starts_at <= NOW()) AND (c.ends_at IS NULL OR c.ends_at >= NOW()) ORDER BY c.is_recommended DESC, preferred DESC, c.display_order, c.created_at DESC
SELECT organization_id AS organizationId, name FROM donation_organization WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO member_donation_preference (member_id, organization_id) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{organizationId})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, o.name AS organization_name FROM donation_campaign c JOIN donation_organization o ON o.organization_id = c.organization_id AND o.is_active = 1 WHERE c.campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND c.is_active = 1 AND (c.starts_at IS NULL OR c.starts_at <= NOW()) AND (c.ends_at IS NULL OR c.ends_at >= NOW())

SELECT member_id, piggy_bank_enabled AS piggyBankEnabled, saving_unit AS savingUnit, auto_donate_enabled AS autoDonate, auto_donate_campaign_id AS autoDonateCampaignId FROM donation_setting WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO donation_setting (member_id) VALUES (#{memberId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id = VALUES(member_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE donation_setting SET piggy_bank_enabled = #{piggyBankEnabled}, saving_unit = #{savingUnit}, auto_donate_enabled = #{autoDonate}, auto_donate_organization_id = #{organizationId}, auto_donate_campaign_id = #{campaignId}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT dh.* FROM donation_history dh JOIN wallet w ON w.wallet_id = dh.wallet_id WHERE w.member_id = #{memberId} AND dh.idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO donation_history (wallet_id, organization_id, campaign_id, channel_id, txn_id, amount, status, recipient_name, receipt_url, idempotency_key, completed_at) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{organizationId}, #{campaignId}, #{channelId}, NULL, #{amount}, 'COMPLETED', #{recipientName}, NULL, #{idempotencyKey}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE donation_campaign SET raised_amount = raised_amount + #{amount}, participant_count = participant_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE campaign_id = #{campaignId} AND is_active = 1
mapper.select: SELECT dh.*, o.name AS organization_name, c.title AS campaign_title FROM donation_history dh LEFT JOIN donation_organization o ON o.organization_id = dh.organization_id LEFT JOIN donation_campaign c ON c.campaign_id = dh.campaign_id WHERE dh.wallet_id = #{walletId} ORDER BY dh.created_at DESC

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `transaction` (wallet_id, counter_wallet_id, pet_id, txn_type, price, category, merchant_name, memo, auto_tagged, idempotency_key, transfer_purpose, txn_date) VALUES (#{sourceWalletId}, #{counterWalletId}, NULL, 'TRANSFER', #{amount}, 'ETC', '짜투리 저금통', #{memo}, 'N', #{idempotencyKey}, #{transferPurpose}, NOW())

SELECT ds.member_id AS memberId, ds.saving_unit AS savingUnit FROM donation_setting ds WHERE ds.piggy_bank_enabled = 1 AND (ds.last_spare_trimmed_on IS NULL OR ds.last_spare_trimmed_on < #{today}) ORDER BY ds.member_id
mapper.update: UPDATE donation_setting SET last_spare_trimmed_on = #{today}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND (last_spare_trimmed_on IS NULL OR last_spare_trimmed_on < #{today})
mapper.select: SELECT t.txn_id AS txnId, w.member_id AS memberId, t.price AS amount, ds.saving_unit AS savingUnit FROM `transaction` t JOIN wallet w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id JOIN donation_setting ds ON ds.member_id = w.member_id AND ds.piggy_bank_enabled = 1 LEFT JOIN donation_roundup dr ON dr.source_txn_id = t.txn_id WHERE t.txn_type = 'PAYMENT' AND t.price >= 0 AND t.txn_date >= CURDATE() AND t.txn_date < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND dr.roundup_id IS NULL ORDER BY t.txn_date, t.txn_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO donation_roundup (source_txn_id, wallet_id, saving_unit, roundup_amount, status) VALUES (#{sourceTxnId}, #{walletId}, #{savingUnit}, #{roundupAmount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE donation_roundup SET status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = NOW() WHERE roundup_id = #{roundupId} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT ds.member_id AS memberId, ds.auto_donate_campaign_id AS campaignId FROM donation_setting ds JOIN wallet w ON w.member_id = ds.member_id AND w.wallet_type = 'DONATION' AND w.balance > 0 WHERE ds.auto_donate_enabled = 1 AND ds.auto_donate_campaign_id IS NOT NULL AND (ds.last_auto_donated_year_month IS NULL OR ds.last_auto_donated_year_month <> #{yearMonth}) ORDER BY ds.member_id
mapper.update: UPDATE donation_setting SET last_auto_donated_year_month = #{yearMonth}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND auto_donate_enabled = 1
